incident-bot: INCIDENT 4967 — p99 latency spike on /v1/infer streaming and elevated tail latency. Auto-page to #incidents and oncall-sre. severity: high, suspected deps: control-plane config fetch / feature-flag propagation.

oncall-sre: ack — seeing p95 ~420ms -> p99 ~2.1s for streaming RPCs across eu-west-1 and us-west-2, error rate small but stalls increasing. metrics: streaming.active_stalls +350% in last 5m.

alice (runtime): adding context — runtime saw long waits on configstore fetchs when opening new session: logs show repeated 502/504 from config-proxy for key feature:stream-prefetch. KV cache hit rate dropped from 98% -> 54%.

ben (infra): trace shows configstore pod restarts around 2026-03-15T08:12Z in eu-west-1, OOMKilled on node group autoscaler churn. Noted spike lines:
```
2026-03-15T08:12:07Z config-proxy[pid=34]: ERR fetch /cfg/flags failed status=504 latency=1203ms
2026-03-15T08:12:09Z proxy: warn connection pool exhausted
```

carla (platform): if KV cache misses increased, streaming sessions fallback to config fetch per request causing head-of-line stalls. Immediate mitigation: enable local static fallback for stream-prefetch flag and increase cache ttl. Can we flip a runtime-side local override?

alice (runtime): yes — we have emergency localOverride that bypasses control-plane for reads. Command: `POST /admin/local-override` payload `\{"flag\":\"stream-prefetch\",\"value\":true,\"ttl_s\":3600\}`. I'll run it in eu-west-1 now.

oncall-sre: go for it. Also suggest reducing default open sessions to reduce concurrent config requests: runtime config `max_concurrent_stream_sessions=500` -> 250. Frank, can you patch?

frank (eng): applying change to runtime config in eu-west-1 via k8s patch now: `kubectl -n redwood set env deployment/runtime MAX_CONCURRENT_STREAM_SESSIONS=250 --record`. Rolling update started.

ben (infra): I'm spinning a small scale-up for configstore in eu-west-1 (2 -> 4 replicas), and tainting node with more memory headroom. Will monitor restarts.

alice (runtime): local override posted. Confirmed KV hit rate recovering to ~85% after ~45s. p99 dropped from 2.1s -> 760ms (first improvement).

dave (product): customer impact question — which customers hit this, any high-value accounts impacted?

eve (support): quick list from errors: three customers had elevated error retries: AcmeCorp (critical), BrightHealth (medium), internal-canary. AcmeCorp saw increased 504 clients for streaming sessions between 08:11-08:20 UTC, estimated impacted requests ~12k, resumed after override/scale. We're drafting notice.

oncall-sre: root cause hypothesis: configstore memory pressure during a background compaction + a release of an aggressive flag rollout causing fanout requests on first read. That + autoscaler churn created transient 504s and a cache cold wave — led to tail stalls.

carla (platform): long-term: add per-tenant jitter to flag propagation, require warm reads from cached copy before pulling fresh, and better pod disruption budgets for configstore. Short-term: keep local override for 1h and monitor.

frank (eng): also applied a temporary rate-limit around config-fetch at edge: `x-config-fetch-rate = 200r/s` per-region to shed noisy clients. We'll relax after system stabilizes.

ben (infra): configstore replicas scaled to 4, node churn reduced, no further OOMs. CPU steady, mem usage trending down.

alice (runtime): metrics update @ 08:20 UTC: p95=310ms, p99=620ms, streaming.active_stalls down to baseline+20%. Errors normalized.

dave (product): request timeline + impact summary for postmortem/comms: can someone add short bullet list of actions taken and mitigation window?

frank (eng): actions: 1) applied runtime local override for stream-prefetch 2) lowered max concurrent stream sessions 3) k8s patch applied and rolling update 4) scaled configstore replicas 5) temporary rate-limit on config fetch 6) monitoring and rollback guard added. Mitigation window: 08:12 -> 08:22 UTC (10m to stabilization).

alice (runtime): logs snippet showing recovery:
```
2026-03-15T08:19:05Z runtime: INFO kv_cache hit_rate=0.86
2026-03-15T08:19:06Z runtime: INFO stream-session create latency=120ms
2026-03-15T08:20:10Z runtime: INFO p99_stream_latency=620ms
```

incident-bot: incident status -> mitigated (partial). Severity -> reduced to medium. Oncall -> handoff to next oncall in 30m.

oncall-sre: handing off to night-sre at 08:30 UTC — summary: configstore OOM -> 504s -> KV coldwave -> streaming p99 spike. Actions in place, continue monitoring, rollback plan if overrides cause regressions. Next steps for oncall: keep override for 1h, watch p99 and KV hit_rate per region, follow infra runbook for configstore memory tuning.

carla (platform): tagging for postmortem: need SLO impact numbers (p95/p99 delta and error budget consumed) and customer scope. I'll own triage doc.

eve (support): drafting customer postmortem/notification for AcmeCorp. Will propose language: we experienced transient increases in streaming latency due to control-plane config service instability; mitigations applied and service restored within 10 minutes.

dave (product): please attach any relevant dashboards and a short RCA bullet list to the incident ticket. We'll schedule a follow-up with infra and runtime on hardening.

frank (eng): follow-up items assigned: configstore compaction tuning (ben), add fallback cache path in runtime (alice), improved rollout gating for flags (carla). I'll open tickets.

oncall-sre: final note before handoff — if p99 creeps above 1s again, engage full bridge. I'll be available for the handoff. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: incident 4967: closed to active monitoring at 08:30 UTC.
